name: Oxyotl
canonNotes: A Chameleon Skink who hunts the servants of Chaos across the world, guided by the visions of the Slann.
Master of stealth and poison darts; appears and vanishes at will.
voiceNotes: Quiet, alien and watchful; speaks rarely, as a hunter.
Focused on Chaos and on the Slann's visions.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
